Do you want to build production AI systems that change how the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy deploys capital? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Digital & AI team in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Team

As Forward Deployed Engineer, you will join the Digital & AI team in CIP Fund Solutions, reporting to the Investment Lifecycle Lead. You will be part of a new delivery unit, developing and rolling out digital and AI solutions that bring efficiency to CIP’s investment teams, and you will set the unit’s technical direction.

Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you work alongside the investment teams who use your systems, learn the documents and decisions they handle, and turn that knowledge into production software.

You will design, build and run the AI systems that support CIP’s investment lifecycle, working with data rooms, contracts, financial models and investment committee materials, and you will set the engineering standards that let CIP scale AI across teams.

Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

• Design, build and run production AI systems for the investment lifecycle, owning integrations, reliability and monitoring.

• Build retrieval, document-processing and agent-based workflows over data rooms, contracts, due diligence reports and financial models.

• Define and run evaluations that test accuracy and reliability against CIP-specific benchmarks.

• Build in access control, data segregation between funds and audit trails from day one.

• Integrate with CIP’s Microsoft 365 and data platforms, working with IT and Security to run solutions as supported services.

• Set engineering standards and reusable components and help build the engineering team as the unit grows.

You

You hold a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, and bring 5-8 years of software engineering experience, including at least two years building LLM-powered systems in production. You write production code in Python plus TypeScript or C#, and have hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation, tool use and agents, structured extraction and model evaluation.

You also bring cloud engineering experience on Azure or a comparable platform, and a solid grasp of security and data governance in sensitive data environments.

Experience in financial services, energy or another regulated industry is a strong advantage.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• Ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

• Enjoy working face-to-face with users and turning their feedback into working software.

• Calm and decisive when delivery is urgent and requirements are unclear.

• High standards and ownership, from prototype through to production.

• Excellent written and verbal English. Danish is not a requirement.

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

CIP Fund Solutions

CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

Für das Hotel Hesselet wird ein Kellner gesucht.

Möchten Sie dazu beitragen, ein neues Restauranterlebnis im Hotel Hesselet zu eröffnen? Am 1. März 2027 eröffnen wir das Restaurant Hi – ein neu erbautes Pavillonrestaurant im Hotel Hesselet, das als exklusives kulinarisches Universum mit offener Küche, einladendem Ambiente und einem starken Fokus auf Gastfreundschaft, Kultur und ganzheitliche Erlebnisse geschaffen wurde.

Das Hotel Hesselet liegt an einem der schönsten Orte Fünens. Direkt dort, wo der Wald auf das Meer trifft und man die Brücke zwischen Seeland und Fünen sehen kann. Das Hotel befindet sich in Nyborg, das im Mittelalter der Treffpunkt des Königs mit den wichtigsten Persönlichkeiten des Reiches war. Heute ist das Hotel ein Ort der Begegnung, an dem Gastfreundschaft zur Geborgenheit wird.

Das Hotel ist nach dem Wald benannt, in dem es liegt. Hesselet bedeutet „Ort, wo die kleinen Haselnusssträucher wachsen“. Wir sind stolz darauf, zu Dänemarks beliebtesten Strandhotels zu gehören und bemühen uns, all unseren Gästen ein außergewöhnliches Erlebnis zu bieten – egal ob sie bei uns übernachten, speisen oder an einer Konferenz teilnehmen.

Das Hotel Hesselet verändert sich – und ist in guten Händen

Im Jahr 2024 wurde das Hotel Hesselet vom Carama Family Office übernommen, das eine klare Vision verfolgt: die Seele von Hesselet zu bewahren und gleichzeitig das Hotel für zukünftige Gästeerlebnisse weiterzuentwickeln – ohne dabei die Geschichte und die Wärme des Ortes zu beeinträchtigen.

Die neuen Eigentümer haben mit einer behutsamen Renovierung der Hoteleinrichtungen, des Restaurants und der Außenanlagen begonnen. Es wird sowohl in das Ambiente als auch in die Mitarbeiter investiert – mit einem starken Fokus auf Professionalität, Wohlbefinden und erstklassigen Service.

Das Ziel ist ambitioniert, aber klar: Das Hotel Hesselet soll zu den attraktivsten Hotels Dänemarks zählen – sowohl für Gäste als auch für Mitarbeiter. Hier soll man die besondere Ruhe, Qualität und Atmosphäre spüren können, für die Hesselet seit 1967 bekannt ist – in einer zeitgemäßen und modernen Interpretation.

Möchten Sie dazu beitragen, exzellenten Service und großartige Gästeerlebnisse zu bieten?

Wir suchen einen Kellner, der Teil eines kompetenten Teams werden möchte, in dem stolze Traditionen, hohe Qualität und eine gute Atmosphäre Hand in Hand gehen.

Als Teil unseres Servicepersonals arbeiten Sie in unserem Restaurant, in Veranstaltungsräumen und bei Konferenzen.

Sie werden ein wichtiger Bestandteil des Gästeerlebnisses sein – vom Frühstück und Mittagessen bis zum Abendservice und besonderen Veranstaltungen.

Wir bieten:

• Ein starkes, engagiertes Team mit tollen Kollegen und einem Fokus auf Zusammenarbeit

• Ein Arbeitsplatz mit hohem Serviceniveau und vielen Stammkunden

• Möglichkeit zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung und Übernahme von Verantwortung

• Ein abwechslungsreicher Alltag mit alltäglichen Gästen, Partys und Treffen

• Eine fantastische Lage und ein Haus mit Seele und Geschichte

Wir erwarten von Ihnen Folgendes:

• Er ist ein Kellner und legt großen Wert auf guten Service und Gastfreundschaft.

• Behalten Sie den Überblick, bleiben Sie ruhig und lächeln Sie – auch wenn es mal hektisch zugeht.

• Ist flexibel und kann Termine einhalten

• Blüht in Teamarbeit auf, kann aber auch selbstständig Verantwortung übernehmen.

• Ich interessiere mich für Wein, Essen und Gästeerlebnisse.

Arbeitsumfeld

Im Hotel Hesselet pflegen wir eine herzliche, familiäre und freundschaftliche Atmosphäre – sowohl unter Kollegen als auch gegenüber unseren Gästen. Wir sind überzeugt, dass die besten Ergebnisse durch echte Zusammenarbeit, gegenseitige Präsenz und Interesse entstehen.

Wir erwarten von Ihnen, dass Sie Ihre Persönlichkeit, Ihre Energie und Ihr Engagement einbringen – sowohl in Ihrer Arbeit als auch im Umgang mit Kollegen und Gästen. Im Gegenzug bieten wir Ihnen ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem wir uns gegenseitig unterstützen und als Team zusammenarbeiten, wobei Wohlbefinden und Erfolg gleichermaßen im Fokus stehen.

Wir arbeiten intensiv daran, einen der besten Arbeitsplätze der Branche in Dänemark zu schaffen – und als Teil unseres Serviceteams werden Sie Teil eines engagierten und dynamischen Unternehmens mit ambitionierten Zielen und hoher Professionalität. Wir bieten gute Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein gesundes Arbeitsumfeld und viel Raum, um mit den Aufgaben zu wachsen.

Gehalt und Konditionen

Gehalt nach Qualifikation. Zusätzlich bieten wir Altersvorsorge, Krankenversicherung und weitere Beschäftigungsbedingungen gemäß Tarifvertrag und gegebenenfalls weiterer Vereinbarung. Es handelt sich um eine Vollzeitstelle mit frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin oder nach Vereinbarung.

Senden Sie Ihre Bewerbung und Ihren Lebenslauf an unseren Restaurantleiter Rasmus Weimar unter rasmus@hesselet.dk – am besten so bald wie möglich, da wir laufend Vorstellungsgespräche führen.

Sollten Sie Fragen zur Stelle haben, können Sie ihn gerne direkt unter der Telefonnummer (45) 65 31 30 29 kontaktieren.

Klingt das nach etwas, von dem Sie gerne hören würden? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, von Ihnen zu hören.

• Embed with investment teams to map workflows and quantify where AI adds value.

Are you passionate about transforming raw data and AI model predictions into meaningful, real-world metrics for professional American football players? Then come and join our ambitious and collaborative product team!

Data is revolutionizing sports. Join our team to play.

This is a great opportunity to join our growing New Sports team within our Tracking Department. Our team is responsible for the development of the firmware for our American football products. We are developing cutting-edge solutions that leverage deep learning, classic computer vision, machine learning, and signal processing algorithms to deliver product features. Through our market leading radar and computer vision-based tracking technology, we are building products used by some of the best athletes in the world.

Example projects we are working on:

• 
Detecting and tracking objects, such as balls, players, and clubs, across several different sports

• 
Optical flow for determining ball flight characteristics

• 
Calibration between radar and camera data for drawing tracks in broadcast television

• 
Human pose tracking for analyzing athlete performance

Are you our new colleague?

Our ideal candidate is specialized the area of computer vision and machine learning. You will be joining a team of specialists within these fields and together we strive to remain the best in the world at what we do. Your responsibilities will include development of new and existing products and core processes based on your experience and skills.

In the new sports team we value teamwork and openness. Therefore, we expect you to enjoy working with other highly motivated colleagues and help provide a good working environment. Develop advanced DL, ML, classic computer vision, algorithms.

• 
Write production ready code, with emphasis on deployment, monitoring and supportability

Design and execute experiments to acquire and prepare datasets for algorithm development

• 
Develop and extend tooling for computer vision development. This can include data visualization, annotation and debugging

• 
Develop appropriate system architecture for edge-based and server solutions

• 
Collaborate with engineers within Vision & AI and the tracking department to produce high quality cutting edge systems

Job requirements

• 
Master’s Degree or Ph.D. in computer vision, machine learning, computer science, mathematical modelling, or equivalent

• 
3+ years of practical experience in implementing and deploying computer vision systems, with a proven track record of successful project execution and system optimization

• 
Strong software development and programming skills within Python and C++

• 
Experienced in computer vision techniques, including object detection, video tracking, and image analysis, as well as deep learning and convolutional neural networks in machine learning

• 
You have an entrepreneurial mindset and thrive on taking an idea from concept to a polished implementation.

Nice to haves:

• 
Experience with or knowledge of image acquisition, camera calibration

Preferably experience with or knowledge of video formats and camera hardware, drivers and low-level software

Working in a fast-paced, team-based environment also demands a certain degree of self-planning, as well as the ability to work independently. Your colleagues are highly skilled, innovative and pro-active in their work approach. They possess strong analytical skills, are good communicators in English, and take pride in their job and deliverables. We expect you to be of a similar caliber.

We offer:

• 
Highly skilled colleagues

• 
World class office facilities

• 
International environment with more than 35 nationalities in our HQ

Social activities

Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Do you enjoy finding the biggest commercial opportunities, improving customer journeys, and turning data into initiatives that drive measurable growth? Keep reading!

At Limepack, E-commerce is at the heart of how we acquire and convert customers across Europe. As we grow, we see significant potential to improve the customer journey and webshop performance across our markets, while becoming much better at what happens after the first purchase: building stronger relationships, increasing repeat purchases, and growing customer lifetime value.

With our current E-commerce Manager going on maternity leave, this role has a unique starting point. You’ll initially take ownership of E-commerce growth and customer journey optimisation, but this is not simply a 10–12 month maternity cover. The role is designed to evolve with you: over time, your focus will shift towards becoming Limepack’s Loyalty Lead, taking long-term ownership of Post-Purchase, CRM & Lifecycle.

This is a role for someone who combines commercial thinking with strong execution. You’ll use data to identify where the biggest opportunities are, set priorities, and drive initiatives across teams, taking responsibility for turning ideas into measurable results.

📋 Your responsibilities and impact

Your focus will evolve as you grow into the role: starting with E-commerce and gradually taking ownership of Loyalty, CRM, Email and Lifecycle.

• Grow E-commerce performance: Own and improve webshop conversion, customer journeys, AOV and revenue across markets. Identify the biggest opportunities and turn them into scalable improvements.

• Lead and collaborate across our tech setup: For the first 10–12 months, you will lead Alexander, our UX/Frontend Developer, who will report to you, while you report to our CCO. You will also work closely with our two Backend Developers and external partners to bring initiatives from idea to implementation.

• Turn data into priorities: Use customer and commercial data to understand where we should focus, build a clear roadmap, and follow up on the KPIs that matter.

• Drive projects from idea to impact: Lead high-impact initiatives across teams, create clear ownership, and make sure the right people and resources come together to deliver on time.

• Build for scale: Look beyond one-off improvements and create solutions that can work effectively across Limepack’s European markets.

• Build our Loyalty engine: After 10-12 months, own and improve the customer journey beyond the first purchase across Post-Purchase, CRM, Email and Lifecycle. Build stronger customer relationships, increase repeat purchases and grow customer lifetime value.

What success looks like: Within your first 12 months, you’ll aim to increase webshop conversion by 30%, help deliver our 2027 E-commerce revenue target of 40M in new business, and establish clear ownership and priorities for Loyalty. Longer term, you’ll drive improvements in repeat purchase rate, CLV and lifecycle revenue, including increasing first-to-second-purchase retention from 40% to 50%.

👉 Who you are

• You think commercially: You naturally look for the opportunities that will have the biggest impact on revenue and customer value, rather than simply working through a list of tasks.

• You are analytical and curious: You enjoy digging into data, understanding what customers are doing, and using those insights to decide what to improve next.

• You make things happen: You take ownership from opportunity to execution, create structure around projects, and follow through until the result is delivered.

• You are always looking for a better way: You enjoy improving customer journeys, processes and systems and think about how solutions can be scaled rather than solving the same problem repeatedly.

• You are strong across teams: You’re comfortable driving projects through people you don’t directly manage, aligning different stakeholders, and creating clarity around priorities and ownership.

🎓 Your experience

To succeed in this role, you should bring a strong combination of E-commerce experience, commercial thinking, analytical skills and project ownership.

• You have 3–5 years of relevant experience, ideally in E-commerce, digital growth, CRO, CRM, lifecycle marketing, or a similar commercially focused role.

• You have owned E-commerce performance and can point to measurable commercial results you personally helped create.

• You have hands-on experience with CRO and customer journey optimisation and know how to turn insights into improvements.

• You are strong with data, prioritization and project management, and are comfortable coordinating initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholders.

• Experience with CRM, lifecycle, retention or multi-market E-commerce is a strong advantage.

🚀 Who We Are

Limepack is a profitable Copenhagen-based European scale-up making custom-branded takeaway packaging accessible to businesses of all sizes. Since 2018, we’ve expanded across 14 countries by partnering with European manufacturers to offer faster, more affordable, and more sustainable packaging solutions.

We’re growing fast: we’ve been named a Børsen Gazelle four years in a row for exceptional revenue growth (Limepack.com/growth), and our ambition is to triple revenue over the next three years.

Today, we’re a team of 33 people, including 14 remote colleagues. We put a lot of emphasis on building a great place to work, and we’re proud to be a certified Happy Workplace (Limepack.com/happy). 🚀

💚 We offer:

• A full-time position based in Copenhagen with flexibility to work from home.

• A competitive salary based on experience.

• 6 weeks of paid time off, pay during sick days, and generous paid parental leave.

• The opportunity to take ownership of an important commercial area and grow from E-commerce ownership into leading Limepack’s Loyalty, CRM & Lifecycle agenda.
